text: This staff report is a matter that Community Council has delegated authority to make a final decision, provided that it is not amended so that it varies with City policy or by-laws. Transportation Services is requesting approval to extend the existing maximum 10-minute parking limit on the west side of Cheston Road by additional 22 metres further north. The proposed extension will allow an additional three to four vehicles to drop-off/pick-up students to/from Maurice Cody Junior Public School.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Amended the existing maximum ten-minute parking limit in effect, from 8:30 a.m. to 9:15 a.m., from 11:15 a.m. to 1:15 p.m., and from 3:00 p.m. to 4:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Cheston Road, between a point 50 metres north of Belsize Drive and a point 115 metres further north, to be in effect from a point 50 metres north of Belsize Drive to a point 137 metres further north. 2. Amended the existing parking prohibition in effect, from 9:15 a.m. to 11:15 a.m., from 1:15 p.m. to 3:00 p.m., and from 4:00 p.m. to 6:00 p.m., Monday to Friday, on the west side of Cheston Road, between a point 50 metres north of Belsize Drive and a point 115 metres further north, to be in effect from a point 50 metres north of Belsize Drive to a point 137 metres further north. 3.
